# Masterplan

## Build path

the only copy of the maintenance history.

Last checked: 2026-09-10

## What it does, and for whom

Ward Notes lets nurses on one ward see the recommended treatment for each
patient and record what they did. Eleven staff use it.

## What happens when it fails

Nurses fall back to the paper protocol on the ward. Priya owns recovery.
